description.zh: 重置系统时使用的镜像ID。
description.en: The image ID that is used when you reinstall the OS.
The reserved parameter. This parameter is not supported.

description.zh: 新密钥对名称。不传入该参数时，需要在重置成功后重新设置密钥对。
description.en: The name of the new key pair. If you do not specify this parameter, you must reset the key pair after the OS is reinstalled.

description.zh:
RDS Custom实例的新登录密码。不传入该参数时，需要在重置成功后重新设置登录密码。

- 支持长度为8~30个字符。
- 必须同时包含大小写英文字母、数字和特殊符号中的三类字符。 特殊符号可以是：()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=。
description.en:
The new logon password of the RDS Custom instance. If you do not specify this parameter, you must reset the logon password after the OS is reinstalled.

*   The value must be 8 to 30 characters in length.
*   The value must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. Supported special characters include: ( ) \` ~ ! @ # $ % ^ & \* - \_ + =

descriptions.zh:
- 实例的状态必须为已暂停（Stopped）状态。
- 重装系统将丢失原系统盘上的数据，请谨慎操作。
descriptions.en:
*   The instance must be in the Stopped state.
*   If you reinstall the system, the data on the original system disk is lost. Exercise caution when you perform this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds replace-rc-instance-system-disk --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-2zec4lvlhcdkyd130000 --instance-id rc-m5ei7b1w38w2l91x0000 --password testPassword --biz-key-pair-name testKeyPairName --is-local-disk false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds ReplaceRCInstanceSystemDisk --region cn-hangzhou --KeyPairName testKeyPairName --InstanceId 'rc-m5ei7b1w38w2l91x0000' --IsLocalDisk false --ImageId 'm-2zec4lvlhcdkyd130000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Password testPassword
